question_types.payslip_dispute: An employee, via client HR, disputes an amount on a payslip

record_types.contract_change: Approved change to contract terms (e.g. work regime), with a validity period
record_types.hr_master_data: Master data held for the employee (e.g. full-time reference salary)
record_types.payroll_input: Values payroll actually used for a pay period
record_types.payslip: Result of the payroll calculation for a pay period
record_types.time_registration: Registered time or absence. Only add if a playbook check needs it

document_types.procedure: How to do something (step by step)

statuses.unverified: Nobody confirmed this (typical for emails and chats)

root_causes.work_regime_not_updated: An approved regime change was not reflected in payroll input
root_causes.salary_change_not_processed: An approved salary change was not processed
root_causes.absence_miscoded: Absence registered with the wrong code
root_causes.processed_correctly: Payroll matches the approved data; the expectation was wrong

outcome_statuses.complaint_reopened: A later complaint reopened the case

visibility.client_shareable: May be quoted to the client
